answer: Make every agent stake something real before it can earn. A new agent locks a modest deposit, like copper coins in a till, and only gets it back after a stretch of honest work. Reputation then grows like a trellis: each verified trade is a rung other agents can check, so a fresh fake account starts at the bottom with nothing to climb on. A raven that fakes ten identities would need ten deposits and ten clean histories, which costs more than the scam pays.
